verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships Visalaw AI, which claims to 'automate entire workflows', so a recurring-schedule axis is a fair question here. The evidence describes only one-off, on-demand tasks such as drafting, extraction and research prompts. Nothing documents scheduled or recurring job execution, and a one-off automation is not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
